prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
Top online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice span structured depth psychology, self-paced digital platforms, and free educational tracks:
Jung Platform (Engage the Shadow / All Courses): Features comprehensive programs taught by prominent Jungian analysts and authors like James Hollis and Polly Young-Eisendrath. It focuses heavily on Carl Jung's shadow theory, dreamwork, and individuation for both beginners and advanced seekers. Jung Platform
Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course: Designed for those who want to integrate shadow work into a coaching or healing practice, covering internal family systems, the Golden Shadow, voice dialogue, and theory. Courses For Success
Sounds True (Online Spirituality Courses): Offers digital programs from renowned teachers like Tara Brach, Pema Chödrön, and Eckhart Tolle, blending emotional integration, mindfulness, and spiritual awakening. Sounds True
Shadow Work Course and Workbook – Udemy: Created by Elaina Bianca, this beginner-to-intermediate course includes a 98-page companion workbook, guided meditations, and journaling prompts to transform core triggers and fears. Udemy
Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self – Udemy: A rated practical course by Melanie Stevens focusing on inner reflection, trigger identification, projection, and shadow communication. Udemy
Hunt Your Own Shadow – Zachary Phillips: A free 12-week self-paced course utilizing mindfulness, inner child work, journaling, and guided self-inquiry.
Shadow Work Playlist – YouTube (Jordan Thornton): A curated 5-hour video series and playlist covering Jungian shadow integration, somatic therapy, releasing repressed emotions, and breaking trauma bonds. YouTube·Jordan Thornton - Inner Work +1
